status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 through rc.7 are unchanged and still downloadable; this is a separate immutable archive. The engine inside it moves from 0.1.1-rc.7 to 0.1.1-rc.8, which takes ΔT from an observed model with a band instead of astronomy-engine's 2004 polynomial: in 2026 ΔT is 69.20 s where rc.7 used 75.50 s, and positions move by the difference, the Moon by about 3.4″. Every calculation record now carries the ΔT it was computed with and names its ephemeris, under a new conventions set; records written by rc.3 to rc.7 still parse and compare. A chart outside 1800–2200 carries a new outside-reference-span flag; this adapter's epoch lies inside that span, so none of its own charts does. The comparison changes where records now carry ΔT: it lists every field of each record's ΔT, a different moment accounts for a different modelled value, a pinned or otherwise different ΔT at one instant is named as a cause of the positions it moves, and a record whose caller pinned ΔT is recalculated with that pin, as the engine's own replay does. A record naming rc.7 is not re-run on this engine, so its differences stay hypotheses.
